text: The purpose of this report is to seek further instruction in relation to a development application for a site that contains a heritage resource and together with other lands is the subject of amongst other matters a zoning by-law amendment application and the related ongoing appeal to the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal.

The Toronto Preservation Board recommends that: 1. City Council adopt the confidential recommendations contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to this report. 2. City Council authorize the public release of the instructions in Confidential Attachment 1 and Confidential Appendices "A" to "D", if adopted by City Council, with the balance of the Confidential Attachment 1 to remain confidential as it contains advice which is subject to solicitor-client privilege.
